specification: see the module docstring of src/tyredeg/paper/recovery.py (written before the run)

recovery_criteria.note: reading aids for 'recovered_all_compounds', not hypothesis tests

estimators.naive_pooled_ols: pooled OLS, compound x age, compound and event intercepts
estimators.fuel_within_run_minus20: fuel-corrected, s/kg 20% too low, within-run OLS
estimators.fuel_within_run_plus20: fuel-corrected, s/kg 20% too high, within-run OLS
estimators.cross_section_cell: within (event, lap, compound) cells, OLS, no run terms
estimators.field_demeaned_ols: within (event, lap) demeaned OLS, no run terms
estimators.eq1_mundlak_run_mean: Eq. 1 + Mundlak run mean of age per compound
estimators.eq1_mundlak_run_mean_slope: Eq. 1 + Mundlak run mean and age x run mean per compound
estimators.eq1_exact_within: Eq. 1, compound columns demeaned exactly within (event, lap) [primary]
estimators.eq1_exact_within_mundlak: Eq. 1 exact within + Mundlak run mean of age per compound

primary_eq1_note: eq1_exact_within is Eq. 1 as now fitted (every fixed-effect column demeaned exactly within (event, lap)); eq1_shipped is the earlier approximate construction, kept as the baseline the correction is measured against; eq1_exact_within_mundlak adds the run-mean covariates to the primary estimator

X1.statement: naive_pooled_ols is biased low (< -0.02 s/lap) in every scenario

X2.statement: fuel_within_run is biased low at the right fuel coefficient and moves by -/+0.0112 s/lap (within 0.002) under a -/+20% fuel error, in every scenario

X3.statement: cross_section_cell and field_demeaned_ols have mean |bias| <= 0.005 under (a) and above it under (b)

X4.statement: eq1_shipped has mean |bias| <= 0.005 and mean coverage in [0.925, 0.975] under (a) and (b)

X5.statement: under (c) eq1_shipped is biased toward zero (mean bias < 0) and its coverage is more than 0.02 below its coverage under (a)

X5b.statement: under (c) the correlated-random-slope variant has smaller mean |bias| than eq1_shipped

X6.statement: the circuit-slope SD of eq1_shipped is biased downward in every scenario

X7.statement: ADDED AFTER THE CORRECTION (not pre-stated): eq1_exact_within has mean |bias| <= 0.005 and mean coverage in [0.925, 0.975] under (a) and (b)

X8.statement: ADDED AFTER THE CORRECTION (not pre-stated): under (c) eq1_exact_within_mundlak has smaller mean |bias| than eq1_exact_within

common.dropped_laps: out-lap of every run and in-lap of every run but the last

exogenous.rule: stop j of n at round(n_laps * j / n + N(0, jitter_sd^2)), independent of pace and wear

pace.rule: as exogenous, plus every stop shifted by -shift * z laps (z = car pace in SDs, slower positive) and P(3 stints) = logistic(logit(p_three_stints) + slope * z)

wear.rule: stop when cumulative loss s*A*(A+1)/2 since the stop (s = the run's realised slope b_c + d_e + v_r) crosses wear_ref_slope * L*(L+1)/2 * exp(N(0, threshold_sd^2)), L = n_laps / n the planned length; clipped to the minimum stint; last stint runs to the flag

audit.seeding: replicate r = r-th child of SeedSequence(seed), shared by all scenarios
